title: Start a price book item from a template

steps.caption: The price book
steps.narration: A template gives you a price book item with the scope of work already written.

steps.caption: From template
steps.narration: On the Price book page, choose From template.

steps.caption: Name, unit, first lines of the scope
steps.narration: Each template shows its name, its unit and the first lines of its scope.

steps.caption: Window replacement
steps.narration: Scroll to the one closest to the work you sell. We'll use Window replacement.

steps.caption: Name and unit filled in
steps.narration: The Add SKU form opens with the name and the unit filled in.

steps.caption: Scope of work, written
steps.narration: The scope of work is written for you. Change any line to match how you work.

steps.caption: Price is yours to set
steps.narration: The price is left empty. That part is yours.

steps.caption: Your price
steps.narration: Type what you charge for one window.

steps.caption: Find the new item
steps.narration: The item is now in your Price Chart. Search to find it.

steps.caption: Price and scope
steps.narration: It has your price, and its scope of work shows on every estimate built from it.

steps.caption: Menu: Price book
steps.narration: You'll find Price book in the menu on the left.

youtube.title: Start a price book item from a template | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of price book templates in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will choose From template, pick a ready-written item, see its name, unit and scope of work filled in, set your own price and save it to your Price Chart.
